literal: Thinking 'we have lost everything', will they suffer grief, those who do not know how to hoard thinking 'we have obtained'?
translation: Will those who do not know how to hoard and gloat when they gain something, ever suffer from grief when they lose it?
modern: நாம் பெற்றுவிட்டோம் என்று எண்ணிக் காப்பாற்றி மகிழத் தெரியாதவர்கள், நாம் இழந்துவிட்டோம் என்று எண்ணித் துன்பப்படுவார்களா?
explanation: This couplet explains the secret to remaining unaffected by adversity and loss. Those who do not get overly attached to gains, and do not spend their time anxiously hoarding or gloating over what they have acquired, will not feel devastated when those things are lost. Since they do not experience the high of possession, they are immune to the low of deprivation. True resilience comes from maintaining equanimity towards both gain and loss.
